title: Paxos regulation timeline
description: A two-column opener (grey eyebrow, a 48px three-line title and a grey lead on the left; a 559×400 image with 8px corners on the right) above a three-column timeline: each entry is a grey year over a hairline, a 24px title and a grey paragraph. On phones it stacks: title, lead, a wide short image, then the entries. Static.
notes: the eyebrow shows from desktop up, like the original
